svg.title: Tool catalogs: how many, and how delivered
svg.desc: Bar chart of enabled tool count per harness and how each is delivered on the first request. Copilot CLI sends all 19 tools flat (8,064 shape tokens). Claude CLI sends all 27 flat (18,877). Copilot in VS Code enables 56 native tools but ships only 23 full schemas on the first request (about 9,200 tokens) and defers the other 33, which carry a defer_loading flag and load on demand when the model calls the built-in tool_search tool. So the harness with the largest catalog carries one of the smallest first-call tool blocks. The full 56-tool catalog would be about 16,600 tokens if sent flat.
svg.text: The biggest catalog is not the biggest first-call block
Enabled tools and how they are delivered on the first request. Claude Sonnet 4.5, MCP off.
Deferred — loaded on demand via tool_search
The two CLIs ship every tool flat. VS Code marks 33 of its 56 tools defer_loading and sends only 23 schemas up front (~9,200 tok); the rest load when the agent calls tool_search.
All 56 tools are native to VS Code (no MCP in this run). The full catalog would be ~16,600 tok if sent flat — deferral keeps ~7,000 tok out of the first request.
Sources: wire/relay bodies (CLIs) and export tools array with per-tool defer_loading flags (VS Code, agent turn). Tool tokens are chars/4 shape estimates.
